response.overview: From the perspective of an 11-year-old boy, his sister and his mother, who in the midst of a political confrontation, try to understand the changes that occur in their environment. The ignorance of their mother, camouflaged as protection, guides them to an unfortunate destination. It is a criticism of political ignorance, indifference to reality and the consequences of choosing not to act.
response.title: Hambre del Silencio
